content:
support-bot: ALERT: spike of 5xxs on POST /v1/generate in hosted-east-1 starting ~1829997600. p95 latency 2.8s -> 9.4s. Multiple customer timeouts and 502/504s. Opening war room. :rotating_light:

emma: joining, pulling grafana dashboards now — looks like request queue depth jumped around 1829997520.

raj: checking auth-proxy logs, I see increased authz latency toward KMS around same window. 502s have upstream 'auth-timeout' in proxy logs.

matt: customer reports: intermittent timeouts, usually after long prompts. Could be KV cache pressure + long seq len. Noting BlueBox prod traffic spike at 1829997480.

sophie: quick mitigation idea: enable fallback routing to smaller model instance pool for high-seq requests, and temporarily increase request timeout at edge to avoid client-level retries. Thoughts?

carlos: agree we should fallback. Deploy gate for fallback config: ``kubectl apply -f fallback-config.yaml``. Rolling out to east-1 now.

emma: deployed fallback config to east-1 canaries. Monitoring error rate. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/hosted/east1/dashboards/requests (sharing snapshot).

raj: auth-proxy team: there's a KMS throttling metric spike for region-east-1 at 1829997465. KMS QPS spiked due to token refresh loop for a subset of clients. Root cause candidate: aggressive retry window in our auth cache layer.

matt: repro steps I'm running locally:
1) send 20 concurrent long-seq requests (seq ~1024) to /v1/generate
2) validate p95 and 5xx rate
3) tail auth-proxy logs for "auth-timeout"

Sample tail snippet:
```
2028-04-12T10:12:04Z auth-proxy[pid=122] WARN auth-timeout user=bluebox-01 token-fetch=1203ms
2028-04-12T10:12:05Z auth-proxy[pid=122] ERROR upstream-unavailable status=504 path=/v1/generate
```

emma: can confirm repro locally with above pattern, reproduces 502/504s when auth-proxy token fetch > 1s and KV cache miss rate > 70%.

sophie: mitigation results: after fallback applied, 5xx rate dropped from 8% -> 1.4% over next 5m. Latency p95 reduced ~40%. Good stopgap.

carlos: next-step checklist (short):
- [ ] auth-proxy: add jitter+backoff on token refresh (owner: raj, due: 2028-04-14)
- [ ] auth cache: increase TTL for validated tokens for high-volume clients (owner: matt, due: 2028-04-15)
- [ ] runtime: add KV cache warmup on model hot-start to reduce cold misses (owner: emma, due: 2028-04-21)
- [ ] gateway: add metric alert for auth-timeout rate pct > 1% (owner: sophie, due: 2028-04-13)

raj: I'll also open a KMS ticket with cloud provider; looks like transient throttling but our token refresh amplifies it. Ticket 987654 opened.

matt: customer comms: BlueBox support ticket updated — we told them fallback applied and we're investigating root cause. Will prepare PSR once postmortem ready.

emma: capturing notes for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = auth cache refresh amplification -> KMS throttle -> auth-proxy timeouts -> gateway 502/504 cascade compounded by KV cache cold misses for long-seq requests.

sophie: action: schedule postmortem meeting Wed 2028-04-18 16:00 UTC. I'll post invite and attach perf traces + repro scripts.

carlos: closing war room in channel. If anyone sees new spikes re-open thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
